annotations.title: Check whether ChatGPT recommends a product

description: Use this when the user wants to know whether AI assistants recommend their product, brand or app — for example 'does ChatGPT mention my product?' or 'which competitors does ChatGPT suggest instead of us?'. It reads the product's homepage, asks ChatGPT five buying questions a customer in that category would ask, and reports which questions named the product and which rival products were named instead, with a 0-100 score. Takes 10-30 seconds; a check of the same product from the last 24 hours is returned instead of re-running. Results come from one run of one assistant and can vary between runs. Do not use it for questions about AI tools in general, for private or login-only sites, or to rank websites in search engines.

category.description: Optional. The category or what buyers are shopping for, e.g. 'meeting transcription'. Read from the homepage when omitted.

product_name.description: The product or brand name exactly as customers know it, e.g. 'Otter.ai'.

url.description: The product's public website, e.g. otter.ai or https://otter.ai

name: check_ai_visibility

category.description: The category or buyer need the questions were about.

fromRecentCheck.description: True when this is a check of the same product run in the last 24 hours.

methodologyUrl.description: How the check works and its limits.

namedIn.description: How many of the questions named the product.
